title: A Flow Intersection at Cerberus Fossae

meta.description: At this location, a portion of the Cerberus Fossae seems to intersect with the edge of a lava flow or other feature nearly perpendicular to the fossae. This could be a good location to investigate stratigraphic relationships and other aspects of the relationship of the fossae to the surrounding terrain. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
